data.name: Nazzeer
data.gender_notes: Nazzeer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root nazara (to watch, observe). This name signifies one who keeps a watchful eye, is vigilant and attentive, and takes care of responsibilities. The name Nazzeer carries the meaning “Keeps watch, observes” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazzeer usually hope their child will grow to embody keeps watch, observes and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of watchfulness and attentiveness
data.etymology: Nazzeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Keeps watch, observes.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazzeer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
